subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

 ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

 ‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

 ‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’

 ‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

 Based on the above, how is M related to Q if ‘M + N − O × P ÷ Q’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: M + N − O × P ÷ Q

M + N → M is the sister of N.

N − O → N is the brother of O.

O × P → O is the wife of P.

P ÷ Q → P is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3018d4b7b68c8e4d000aef82dd211468144b8ccba0e92b7a60ef55adde96d233.png] 

Thus, M is Q's maternal aunt or mother's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
